collection.title: Mazda CX-5 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda CX-5 2017 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this CX-5, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Mazda CX-5 2017 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
